risk_if_not_implemented: Without Use of External Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS), sensitive and/or regulated data may be disclosed, altered or lost through inadequate classification, handling or protection. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Uncontrolled Third-Party Security / Privacy Exposure (R-GV-5), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9), Statutory / Regulatory / Contractual Change (MT-11).

compensating_control_1.name: Third-Party Management
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of third-party management controls.
compensating_control_1.justification: Third-Party Management (TPM-02) provides third-party oversight that compensates for the absence of Use of External Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) (DCH-22) by extending security obligations contractually and monitoring third-party risk in lieu of direct control. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Software Usage Restrictions
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to enforce software usage restrictions to comply with applicable contract agreements and copyright laws.
compensating_control_2.justification: Software Usage Restrictions (CFG-11) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Use of External Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) (DCH-22) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Technology applicability. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
